channel.title: Pier & Point · Avalon at Mission Bay II
channel.description: Changes, corrections and dated milestones for Avalon at Mission Bay II (Mission Bay), San Francisco. Every item names its source.

item.title: Added · Avalon at Mission Bay II: The record had no address
item.description: The record had no address. The Assessor's active lot 8705011 lists the address 301 King St. Added as the record's address. Source: https://data.sf.gov/resource/acdm-wktn.json?blklot=8705011.

item.title: Correction · Avalon at Mission Bay II: The Avalon at Mission Bay II page now also lists…
item.description: The Avalon at Mission Bay II page now also lists AvalonBay's own name for it, Avalon at Mission Bay North II, and a stale note was replaced. Source: AvalonBay Q4 2006 results (investors.avalonbay.com).

item.title: Correction · Avalon at Mission Bay II: The Avalon at Mission Bay II page now says four Assessor…
item.description: The Avalon at Mission Bay II page now says four Assessor lots share its footprint, not many per-unit condominium lots. It also notes that a city permit lists 174 dwelling units where AvalonBay and the Assessor list 313. AvalonBay's release, published January 31, 2007, reports it completed in the fourth quarter of 2006. Source: AvalonBay Q4 2006 results release, January 31, 2007 (investors.avalonbay.com ... 4Q06-results.pdf); DataSF Assessor parcel 8705011; DataSF Building Permits i98e-djp9.

item.title: Correction · Avalon at Mission Bay II: AvalonBay's Q4 2006 earnings release lists Avalon at…
item.description: AvalonBay's Q4 2006 earnings release lists Avalon at Mission Bay North II (313 homes) as completed in that quarter, with initial occupancy in Q3 2006, so the completion milestone moved from June to December 2006, marked approximate. The map caveat now cites that release and the Assessor's 313 units for the unit count and opening; the Arquitectonica page it cited describes a 260-unit project matching the third phase, so the architect claim was dropped. The notes no longer state a three-phase count, and the record's summary now cites the Assessor roll and the AvalonBay release. The parcel citation now links DataSF's record for this parcel instead of the dataset's landing page. The 'Avalon at Mission Bay II' name is kept as Pier & Point's own label and noted as such. Source: AvalonBay Communities, Fourth Quarter 2006 results, 2007-01-31 (https://investors.avalonbay.com/_assets/_507c2c21b8248effea3ae857347c8cf4/avalonbay/db/2294/21588/earnings_release/4Q06-results.pdf); DataSF Assessor Historical Secured Property Tax Rolls, parcel 8705011 (https://data.sf.gov/resource/wv5m-vpq2.json?parcel_number=8705011); DataSF Parcels, blklot 8705011 (https://data.sf.gov/resource/acdm-wktn.json?blklot=8705011); Arquitectonica, Avalon Mission Bay (https://arquitectonica.com/architecture/project/avalon-mission-bay/) (does not state this).

item.title: Complete · Avalon at Mission Bay II: Construction permit completed: DBI recorded… (Oct 23, 2006)
item.description: Construction permit completed: DBI recorded new-construction permit 200105249986 (17 stories, 301 King St) as completed on this date.
